messages.subject: Request for help
parts:
Dear All,

We are preparing for a Rapid Assessment Survey of two important marine=20
turtle foraging habitats in Albania=94 to be held in Albania, from October=20
15th, 2005. The project aims to survey and clarify the sea turtle status=20
at sea (feeding grounds) in two Albanian lagoons. The fieldwork will focus=20
on Rapid Underwater Site Assessments (RUSA) at various locations in those=20
areas based on the information gathered from fishermen surveys=20
(Questionnaires and interviews with local fishermen) and previous=20
scientific data. A series of random dives will be conducted at different=20
locations in selected areas. We plan to use the Line Transect method and=20
Distance V.5 software. Does anyone have relative experience or recommend=20
reference/bibliography for such surveys or has experience for such=20
modelling with Distance V.5.?
=20
Thanks for your help.
=20

Vassilis Kouroutos
Marine Biologist
